content: {"days": [{"day": 1, "title": "Gombu Rock to Druk Museum", "narrative": "Starting with views from Gombu Rock, the day moves through Deshbandu Museum and the Natural history museum, offers a taste of local fare at Street Food Stalls, a relaxing interlude at Nightingale Park, and concludes at the Druk museum."}, {"day": 2, "title": "Tiger Hill to Tomb of Tenzing Norgay", "narrative": "Morning panoramas at Tiger Hill set the tone, followed by the War Memorial at Batasia Loop, the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, lively finds at The Mall Market, and a reflective visit to the Tomb of Tenzing Norgay."}, {"day": 3, "title": "We love Sikkim sign to Gandhi statue", "narrative": "The journey begins at the We love Sikkim sign for a quick photo op, then proceeds to the Gandhi statue, rounding out the visit with a touch of historical resonance."}]}
